name: delegate-alice
description: PROTOTYPE demo bundle for Draft ADR-0115 (agents call each other with no third party in the path). Alice is the human-facing agent: on the offline fake-model tier she calls the auto-mounted curie-delegate MCP tool when the message contains a [fake:delegate:<agent>] marker, since the fake model cannot reason about tool descriptions the way a live model would. See docs/demo/ADR-0115-PROTOTYPE-NOTES.md.
